claims.value: Aya Healthcare member discount of 18%, 20% or 22% off of the Standard Rate at participating Hotels by Wyndham in the U.S. only; for listed brands excluding Hawthorn Suites, stays of 1-13 consecutive nights receive 18% off and stays of 14+ consecutive nights receive 22% off; for Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham, stays of 1-11 nights receive 18% off, 12-29 nights receive 20% off, and 30+ nights receive 22% off.
Offered to any guest who is employed by, associated with or a member of any company, association or group with a then valid membership to Aya Healthcare.

Participating Hotels by Wyndham in the U.S. only; not offered at Wyndham Alltra hotels. Must be booked via the Aya member benefits portal, wyndhamhotels.com with corporate code 1000012794, the toll-free reservation call center at 1-800-407-9832, or the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts app with corporate code 1000012794. Blackout dates and restrictions may apply; rate may not be combined with any other offer or discount.
